artworks.title: Needlework
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the knees up, seated on a cushioned chair or sofa. She is facing forward with a calm expression, wearing a long dress and holding a piece of needlework in her lap. Surrounding her are sketch-like shading indicating soft furnishings. The background lacks distinct features, with soft strokes implying indoor surroundings.

artworks.title: Little Dorothy
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image illustrates the upper three-quarters of a seated person, facing forward. The person's facial features are softly depicted, with gentle lines indicating eyes and a mouth, while their hair is short and slightly tousled. They wear a dress with visible sleeves, and their hands are placed in their lap. No jewelry or accessories are shown. The background is simplistic, featuring sketchy diagonal lines and shading.

artworks.title: Portrait Study: Mrs. Philip
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an individual seated from the waist up. The person is sitting upright, facing slightly towards the viewer, with hands clasped together. The facial features are softly rendered, suggesting a calm expression, and the hair is textured. The clothing is detailed, possibly a loose-fitting garment like a dress or blouse with long sleeves. The setting around the person is minimal, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Savoy Pigeons
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of an urban scene with an elevated view. The scene shows a curving path leading to a bridge in the background. There are buildings and structures sketched in the distance under a lightly clouded sky. The drawing uses soft lines and shading, creating an impressionistic effect. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray on a cream-colored background. Two small figures can be seen walking along the path.

artworks.title: Evening, Little Waterloo Bridge
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a top-down view of a bridge over a river. The bridge occupies the upper third of the composition, creating a horizontal line above the center. It is detailed with soft, sketchy lines indicating shadows and depth. The pencil strokes give the image an impressionistic quality. There are minimal details of vehicles and figures on and near the bridge. Close to us, there are more defined sketches of people and horses moving along a pathway. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray on a cream paper base, accentuating the contrast between dark strokes and the light background. In the distance, the skyline blends into a haze, merging with the atmospheric effects.

artworks.title: Charing Cross Railway Bridge
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene depicted in a monochromatic palette using delicate pencil or charcoal strokes. A small embankment is visible, with indications of figures and vegetation. Various boats are on the river, with some figures sketched aboard. A large bridge crosses the river at the horizon line, partially obscured by soft brushstrokes. Structures can be seen beyond the bridge, with slender spires or chimneys in the skyline. Light and shadow are used effectively in the scene.

artworks.title: Little London
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a cityscape from an elevated viewpoint. There is a distinct dome silhouette on the horizon against a softly clouded sky. The loose and expressive brushstrokes use line work to suggest form and detail. Buildings and structures are outlined with an ethereal quality. The left side of the image has richer detailing with architectural elements rendered in darker tones. A river winds through the scene, with sketched boats. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the contrast between soft shading and stark lines for visual interest and depth.

artworks.title: Waterloo Bridge
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a busy street scene from an elevated viewpoint. A bridge is depicted crossing horizontally, with visible arches. The horizon is faintly defined, with outlines of distant buildings. Quick, fluid strokes create an impressionistic feel, capturing movement. The monochrome color palette emphasizes the pencil or charcoal technique. Carriages and pedestrians move along a wide road lined with sparse trees.

artworks.title: The Thames
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a river with a cityscape in the background. The horizon is slightly above the midpoint of the composition, with various buildings and a tall chimney emitting smoke. The viewpoint appears elevated, providing a wide look over the calm water. The reflection of the scene is visible in the river. The artwork is created with soft, grainy brushstrokes or pencil work blending the elements. The color scheme is monochromatic and the overall atmosphere is serene, with foliage at the bottom of the image adding depth.

artworks.title: Saint Anne's, Soho
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a tall, intricate tower as the focal point, creating a vertical emphasis. The horizon is at the base of the structure where the street level intersects with the base of the building. The artistic technique appears to be a loose, sketchy style rendered in fine lines, possibly with charcoal or pencil, capturing the architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic, using black lines on a cream or off-white background. In front of the tower, there are figures of people and bare-branched trees, providing scale and depth. The building stretches further beyond, adding context to the urban scene.

artworks.title: Sketch of William E. Henley
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's upper body displayed in an expressive style. The man is seated, facing slightly sideways. He has a bearded face with a thick moustache and full beard, short tousled hair, and is depicted wearing what seems like a jacket or overcoat. No specific accessories or objects are shown. The background is blank to highlight the figure. The artist's initials or signature is in small writing at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Butcher's Dog
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban street scene with a building and a cat. The artwork features a sketchy depiction of a street facade with large windows, a partially rolled-up awning overhead, and a simple archway defining the entrance. Additionally, a small cat is depicted sitting in front of the large window. The drawing captures a quiet moment on the street, with light shading and line work giving depth and character to the scene.

artworks.title: The Butcher's Dog
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street view from a slightly elevated perspective, focusing on the entrance of a shop. The scene includes architectural elements such as columns and arches. The brushstrokes are sketchy and spontaneous, creating a sense of movement. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on beige paper. A small dog is in front of the shop window, with a couple of figures nearby. In the distance, there are suggestions of rooftops and upper elements of adjacent buildings.

artworks.title: St. Giles-in-the-Fields
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a building with a steeple, surrounded by bare trees. The viewpoint seems low, emphasizing the steeple and trees. The horizon line is not clear, with the building as the focal point. The sketch is expressive and uses charcoal or pencil, with soft strokes and smudged shading. The color palette is monochromatic - grey and black against a cream background. There are lightly sketched figures and other elements in the lower part of the image, providing scale to the distant structure.

artworks.title: Little London Model
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a standing person facing slightly to the right with arms positioned behind their back. The figure's facial features are softly drawn with a gentle smile suggested, and the hair is wavy and loosely styled. The person is nude, with no clothing depicted. The surroundings show simple lines and shading indicating an interior setting with a rectangular shape and an armchair to the left. The background is blank, emphasizing the focus on the figure with minimalist details suggesting an unfinished artistic approach.

artworks.title: Count Robert de Montesquiou

artworks.medium: transfer lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a suit standing upright with a cane in one hand. He is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt and a bow tie. The man has short, dark hair and a poised posture. The background is slightly textured and abstract.

artworks.title: Count Robert de Montesquiou, No. 2
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man standing upright. He is depicted in a formal suit, with a mustache and short, neatly groomed hair. The man's arms are relaxed at his sides, and he is slightly turned towards the viewer. The background is shaded and textured.

artworks.title: Count Robert de Montesquiou
artworks.artist: Beatrix Godwin Whistler, after James McNeill Whistler
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man standing in a slightly angled posture. He has facial hair and short hair, and is wearing formal attire. The background is simple and focuses on the figure.

artworks.title: The Garden Porch
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. There is no distinct horizon but a line could be imagined along the top portion of the sketch. The line work is delicate, featuring light and varied pencil strokes in an impressionistic style. The color palette is simple, using pencil on beige-toned paper. Figures of people are visible, with one woman prominently wearing a long dress and others gathered in conversation. The background includes architectural elements, such as windows and arches, blending into leafy textures suggesting a garden setting.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Blacksmith
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the upper body of a person turned slightly to the right. The person's head is tilted upwards and slightly to the side, suggesting a seated or leaning position. Facial features are indicated with simple lines, capturing the essence of a profile view with a suggestion of a beard. The hair is represented with soft, dark strokes, appearing short and close to the head. The person seems to be wearing a loose-fitting garment, possibly a shirt, with some visible folds suggested by the sketch lines. There is no jewelry visible, and the person is not holding any objects. The background consists of abstract, textured strokes providing depth but no distinct setting.

artworks.title: Trial Sketch: Grand Rue, Dieppe
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a city scene from an aerial viewpoint. The buildings are sketched lightly with minimal detail in an impressionistic style. There is a lack of a distinct horizon line, focusing more on the middle structures. Small elements like trees or shadows are indicated with dots and lines. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray against a warm-toned background. The scene loses detail in the distance, creating an atmospheric perspective.

artworks.title: Trial Sketch: An Interior
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows scattered dots and lines on a plain background. The arrangement appears linear on a flat surface. Dotted brushstrokes create a suggestive and impressionistic impression, rather than detailed realism. The color palette is monochromatic with black or dark gray dots on a cream-colored background. The composition suggests depth through the density and concentration of dots.

artworks.title: Afternoon Tea
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of two seated individuals, capturing most of their bodies. The person on the left is positioned facing slightly towards the viewer, resting their left arm on a surface and holding their head with their hand. Their head is framed by loose cloth, possibly a shawl or hood. The person on the right is facing slightly away from the viewer, engaged with a book they are holding. They wear a hat adorned with feathers and their hair is likely tucked up. Both individuals wear voluminous traditional attire, with intricate textures. On the table beside them are objects resembling dishes and a small vase with flowers. The background is minimalist, suggesting a simple interior setting.

artworks.title: Portrait Study: Miss Charlotte R. Williams
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows a person standing upright, facing forward with their hands positioned near the front of their body. The facial features are depicted with a neutral expression, and the individual's hair is styled up, potentially with an ornament. The person is dressed in an outfit with billowy sleeves and a lengthy skirt, possibly made of intricately detailed or patterned fabric. The background is plain, highlighting the figure drawn in light graphite or charcoal. There are no visible accessories or objects held by the person. Faint markings or initials are present near the bottom of the drawing.
